remediation_plan.validation: Every mandatory check must report passed, with no high/critical finding and a final decision of approved or explicitly reviewed conditional according to policy.

remediation_plan.title: Rebuild the holdout split before trusting accuracy
remediation_plan.evidence: Feature overlap 1.0; full-row overlap 1.0; train F1 1.0; test F1 1.0; generalization gap 0.0.
remediation_plan.diagnosis: The uploaded evaluation data may not be independent enough to support the reported accuracy claim.
remediation_plan.fix: Create a fresh holdout from raw traffic using time-aware or source-aware splitting, remove duplicate feature rows, lock the file, and rerun the scan without reusing training rows.
remediation_plan.validation: Approve the accuracy claim only when exact overlap is 0%, the train/test F1 gap is below 0.05, and the same result holds on a recent untouched traffic window.

remediation_plan.title: Bind the model artifact to a trusted release identity
remediation_plan.evidence: Artifact traffic_rf_v1 uses .onnx; observed SHA-256 is 16a0a29a0cc9a166163852f16b51c334118a1fe92e7a7f907245e02e3e18f5e3.
remediation_plan.diagnosis: Pickle-family artifacts may execute code when loaded, and metadata-only signature claims do not establish an external chain of trust.
remediation_plan.fix: Create a signed .credora package for this exact SHA-256 using an offline Ed25519 private key, distribute only the public trust key to deployment, and reject raw .onnx uploads outside the trusted packaging pipeline.
remediation_plan.validation: Verify the package with an independently supplied public key, then require the extracted model hash to equal the approved release hash before loading it.
